//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the PROFILE BUTTON — `.pc-navbar__profile-btn` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Layout.profile_button/1`, svelte `profile/ProfileButton.svelte`). A SHELL element migrated DOWN into @keenmate/pure-css, so the class is `pc-navbar__profile-btn` (NOT `pa-*`); confirmed in dist/css/main.css (`.pc-navbar__profile-btn` + the sibling `.pc-navbar__profile-name`). It is an ELEMENT of the `pc-navbar` block but ships as its own component (the navbar END-zone profile trigger), so the fixture `block` is `pc-navbar__profile-btn` (its base class exists in CSS → axis-1 vacuous-scope guard stays quiet; it owns no `--*` modifier or `__*` sub-element). SCOPE = the button + its two spans. Canonical shape from snippets/profile.html + snippets/layout.html: ``. Both wrappers reconcile: a `.pc-navbar__profile-btn`

propsVocabulary.name: display name — rendered in a `.pc-navbar__profile-name` span. Omit → no name span at all. svelte `name`, keen `name`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the root <button class="pc-navbar__profile-btn ..."> (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough; not a core modifier.

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the a11y convention BOTH wrappers carry: aria-label="User Profile" on the <button> (svelte resolves the i18n key to this literal; keen emits the literal — fixed from the old lowercase "User profile" to match the snippet + svelte), and the default icon (`.pa-btn__icon` wrapper + inner `.pa-icon.pa-icon--user` with aria-hidden="true") when no custom icon slot is passed. The `.pc-navbar__profile-name` span appears only when `name` is supplied — both wrappers gate it the same way. No onclick/phx-click (consumer-wired). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The `.pc-navbar__profile-btn` element has NO modifier of its own (no `.pc-navbar__profile-btn--*`) and NO sub-element (no `.pc-navbar__profile-btn__*`). The `name` span's class (`.pc-navbar__profile-name`) is a SIBLING element of the pc-navbar block (not a pc-navbar__profile-btn__* sub-element), so it is not matched by this block's reverse checks — it is exercised directly by the goldens instead. So the contract is: the base class + a name string (→ the name span) + a class passthrough.

name.note: display name → a `.pc-navbar__profile-name` span (exercised by the goldens, not matched by the ^pc-navbar__profile-btn regexes). svelte `name`, keen `name`.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the root pc-navbar__profile-btn button; svelte `class`, keen `class`.

deferred.//: The `.pc-navbar__profile-btn` element owns no `--*` modifier or `__*` sub-element in CSS — nothing axis-1 needs deferred. The custom-icon slot (svelte `icon` snippet / keen `:icon` slot) overrides the default `.pa-icon.pa-icon--user` inside the shared `.pa-btn__icon` wrapper — a shared slot, defaulted (not overridden) in these goldens; acknowledged as PROSE. (`.pa-btn__icon` / `.pa-icon` belong to OTHER blocks — button / icon — and are exercised directly by the goldens.)
deferred.pc-navbar__profile-btn-icon-slot: the custom icon/avatar slot overriding the default user glyph (svelte `icon` snippet, keen `:icon` slot). Both render it inside the same `.pa-btn__icon` wrapper; defaulted in these goldens.

scenarios.name: named
scenarios.note: The blessed shape: the profile trigger with the default user icon + a name span. aria-label="User Profile" is the a11y convention both carry.

scenarios.name: no-name
scenarios.note: No name → NO .pc-navbar__profile-name span (both wrappers gate it on name). The icon-only trigger.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pc-navbar__profile-btn; token order is normalized away.
